ConnectionKind.description: How the Device-Gateway is connected to the mower.
ConnectionKind.title: ConnectionKind

DriveCalibration.description: The fitted drive behaviour of one mower, as stored in the drive link's options.

drive_speed_setting.description: The vendor's manual-driving speed setting during the calibration (`MowerState.drive_speed_mps`); null when the connection has none.
drive_speed_setting.title: Drive Speed Setting

full_yaw_rate_dps.description: Yaw rate at `angular = ±1` in degrees per second.
full_yaw_rate_dps.title: Full Yaw Rate Dps

turn_dead_zone.description: `angular` below which the mower does not turn.
turn_dead_zone.title: Turn Dead Zone

DriveCalibration.title: DriveCalibration

DriveCalibrationResult.description: What a calibration measured and fitted.
DriveCalibrationResult.title: DriveCalibrationResult

DriveCalibrationStatus.description: Progress of the drive calibration on this mower (``MowerState.drive_calibration``).

result.description: The fit, once the calibration is `done`.

DriveCalibrationStatus.title: DriveCalibrationStatus

DriveCalibrationStep.description: One measured step of a calibration.

measured.description: Ground speed in m/s (forward) or yaw rate in degrees per second, left positive (turn); null when too few reports arrived.
measured.title: Measured

outcome.description: `measured` (used by the fit), `skipped` (not driven), `invalid` (too few reports in the steady window), `inconsistent` (the opposite turn disagrees) or `outlier` (breaks the growth with the stick); the last three are left out of the fit.
outcome.title: Outcome

skipped.description: Not driven: the forward distance budget was used up (room ahead).
skipped.title: Skipped

window_s.description: Length of the steady window the value was measured over (the step without its settling time at the start).
window_s.title: Window S

DriveCalibrationStep.title: DriveCalibrationStep

FirmwareInfo.description: The firmware state of a mower (``MowerState.firmware_info``).

available.description: The newest version the vendor offers for this mower; null when none or unknown.
available.title: Available

checked_at.description: When the vendor was last asked; null when never.
checked_at.title: Checked At

failure_reason.description: Why the last update failed, if known.
failure_reason.title: Failure Reason

installed.description: The version running on the mower.
installed.title: Installed

FirmwareInfo.title: FirmwareInfo

GnssSolution.description:
The satellite position solution as the receiver reports it (finer than
:class:`~mowdeck_contracts.v1.RtkFixStatus`, which folds ``single`` into ``none``).
GnssSolution.title: GnssSolution

correction_age_s.description: Age of the last RTK correction data in seconds; null without corrections.
correction_age_s.title: Correction Age S

rtk_status.description: The position solution of the receiver.

JobProgress.description:
The mowing job the mower runs right now (``MowerState.job``).

Null on the state when no job runs or the connection reports none. Times have the
resolution the vendor reports (Mammotion: whole minutes, given here in seconds).

area_id.description: The map area (`MowerMap.areas[].id`) the mower works in now; null when it is not one of the mower's map areas or not reported.
area_id.title: Area Id

elapsed_s.description: Seconds the job has run so far.
elapsed_s.title: Elapsed S

mowed_m2.description: Area mowed in this job so far, in square metres.
mowed_m2.title: Mowed M2

progress_percent.description: Share of the job done, 0 to 100.
progress_percent.title: Progress Percent

remaining_s.description: Seconds the mower estimates the job still needs.
remaining_s.title: Remaining S

JobProgress.title: JobProgress

LinkStatus.description: The state of one additional link as the Device-Gateway reports it in ``MowerState.links``.

compiled_at.description: When the bridge firmware was compiled, as ESPHome reports it (free text).
compiled_at.title: Compiled At

connected.description: The link is open right now.
connected.title: Connected

esphome_version.description: Firmware version of the bridge (the ESPHome release it runs).
esphome_version.title: Esphome Version

outdated.description: The bridge firmware is older than what MowDeck expects; see `outdated_reason`.
outdated.title: Outdated

outdated_reason.description: Why the firmware counts as outdated, e.g. `esphome_version`, `project_version` or `no_project`; null when up to date.
outdated_reason.title: Outdated Reason

project_version.description: Version of the MowDeck bridge template the firmware was built from; null when the firmware carries no `esphome.project`.
project_version.title: Project Version

rssi.description: Signal strength of the mower at the bridge in dBm, if the bridge reports it.
rssi.title: Rssi

since.description: When the link was opened (or lost), if known.
since.title: Since

LinkStatus.title: LinkStatus

MowerActivity.description: What the mower is doing right now.
MowerActivity.title: MowerActivity

MowerErrorCategory.description: What kind of fault ``MowerState.error_code`` names, manufacturer neutral.
MowerErrorCategory.title: MowerErrorCategory

NetworkKind.description:
How the mower itself reaches the internet (its own uplink, not MowDeck's connection to
it, which is ``MowerState.connection``).
NetworkKind.title: NetworkKind

PositionSource.description:
Where :attr:`MowerState.position` comes from, so consumers can judge it.

``rtk`` is the mower's own positioning with an RTK fix (fixed or float), ``gnss`` the same
positioning without an RTK fix (single point, metres of scatter), ``dock`` the known pose of
the charging station while the mower stands in it (the adapter reports the dock instead of
the scattering raw position), ``unknown`` when there is no position or its quality is not
known.
PositionSource.title: PositionSource

RtkFixStatus.description: Quality of the RTK position fix.
RtkFixStatus.title: RtkFixStatus

RtkSource.description: Where RTK correction data comes from.
RtkSource.title: RtkSource

detail.description: With `blocked`: what stops the mower as a lower-case key, e.g. `rain`, `lifted`, `low_battery`, `outside_task_area`, `non_working_hours`, `rtk_not_ready`; the adapter's documentation lists its keys. Null with `ok`.
detail.title: Detail

SelfCheckResult.description: Outcome of the mower's start self-check.
SelfCheckResult.title: SelfCheckResult

mobile_dbm.description: Mobile network (LTE) signal in dBm; null when not reported.
mobile_dbm.title: Mobile Dbm

network.description: The uplink the mower uses now; null when not reported.

wifi_dbm.description: Wi-Fi signal in dBm; null when not reported.
wifi_dbm.title: Wifi Dbm

SpotRunStatus.description: Progress of the spot run MowDeck drives on this mower (``MowerState.spot_run``).

dry_run.description: The blades stayed off for the whole run (the default).
dry_run.title: Dry Run

planned_points.description: Points of the plan in total.
planned_points.title: Planned Points

reason.description: Why the run ended early or paused, if so.
reason.title: Reason

SpotRunStatus.title: SpotRunStatus

TimeWindow.description:
A daily window in the mower's local time, ``HH:MM`` on a 24-hour clock. ``end`` before
``start`` crosses midnight (``22:00`` to ``06:00``).
TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow

TurnStyle.description:
How a spot run turns at the end of a lane (ADR 0043).

``in_place``: the mower rotates on the spot (fast, but an all-wheel-drive mower scuffs the
turf). ``arc``: a forward U-turn with a radius of at least half the lane spacing, or a bulb
turn over the neighbouring lane when the spacing is narrower than the turning radius.
``multi_point``: a three-point turn (forward arc, reverse arc with the blades off, forward
arc); needs a drive link that can reverse (``MowerCapabilities.drive_reverse``).
TurnStyle.title: TurnStyle

description:
A telemetry snapshot of one mower, published on ``telemetry.mower.<id>``.

Two times: ``observed_at`` is when the mower reported the values, ``heartbeat_at`` when the
gateway's link to it was last alive. A docked mower reports rarely, so old values do not mean
an offline mower (ADR 0040).

connected.description: False in the state the Device-Gateway publishes right after its connection to the mower ended: the last known values, with `heartbeat_at` the last time the link was alive. Set by the gateway, never by an adapter.
connected.title: Connected

drive_calibration.description: The drive calibration MowDeck runs on this mower (`DriveCalibrate`, ADR 0042), with its final state and result kept until the next one; null when there never was one.

drive_recoverable.description: With activity `error`: the error is not a safety sensor stop, so manual driving may free the mower (stuck, wheel slip). Lift, tilt and collision stops are never drive recoverable; the controller refuses drive frames for them.
drive_recoverable.title: Drive Recoverable

drive_speed_mps.description: The vendor's speed setting for manual driving (`MowerCapabilities.drive_speed_setting`); null when the connection has none or has not read it yet.
drive_speed_mps.title: Drive Speed Mps

error_category.description: With activity `error`: the manufacturer-neutral kind of the fault; null otherwise or when the connection cannot tell.

firmware_info.description: Installed and available firmware and the update state; null when the adapter has not checked (or cannot check) the vendor.

gnss.description: Satellite positioning details (satellites, RTK correction age, solution); null when the connection does not report them.

heartbeat_at.description: When the Device-Gateway last knew its connection to the mower alive (UTC). The gateway sets it on every publish, never an adapter: it advances with each heartbeat while `observed_at` stays the time of the mower's last report. Clients judge online and offline by it (ADR 0040); null in states from before the field, then `observed_at` stands in.
heartbeat_at.title: Heartbeat At

job.description: The mowing job the mower runs (progress, current area, elapsed and remaining seconds, mowed square metres); null when none runs or the connection does not report it.

light_on.description: Whether the mower's light (the camera's headlamp) is on, as the mower reports it; null when not reported (no light, or no answer yet).
light_on.title: Light On

links.description: State of the mower's additional links by kind (e.g. `ble_bridge`); empty for a mower with only its primary connection.
links.title: Links

observed_at.description: When the device reported this state (UTC).
observed_at.title: Observed At

position_source.description: Where `position` comes from; `unknown` whenever `position` is null.

rain_detected.description: The mower's own rain sensor reports rain right now; null when the connection does not report the sensor (ADR 0046).
rain_detected.title: Rain Detected

raw.description: Adapter specific extras. Consumers must not rely on its structure; the typed fields above replace the keys they cover.
raw.title: Raw

self_check.description: The mower's start self-check (`ok` or `blocked` with the reason); null when the connection does not report it.

settings.description: Current values of the mower's own settings (ADR 0046) by key, as the mower reported them; a declared setting the mower has not reported yet is missing. Types, ranges and options: `MowerCapabilities.settings`.
settings.title: Settings

signal.description: The mower's own Wi-Fi and mobile signal in dBm and its uplink; null when the connection does not report them.

spot_run.description: The spot run MowDeck drives on this mower right now (`SpotMow`), with its final state kept until the next run; null when there never was one.

turn_style.description: How the mower turns at lane ends in its own jobs, as its connection reports the vendor setting (read only; ADR 0043). A spot run without its own `turn_style` uses it; null when the connection does not report one.

title: MowerState
